name: Sound crate
summary: Every song from reels the chat shared, as a crate of drawn records: flip through by dragging, pull the ones you want onto the road trip stack, one friend holds a limited veto stamp, and the stack becomes the playlist.
useWhen: make a playlist from all the songs in the reels we sent
road trip playlist, pull from what's been in the chat
what was that song from the reel, add it to the trip mix
let everyone pick songs but tsai lin gets veto
pick the aux list for saturday from our reels
dontUseWhen: bingo during a concert set (use setlist-bingo)
ranking reels by how funny they were (use reel-rank)
picking one song for a story (use story-beat)

forWhat.description: What the playlist is for, e.g. 'the road trip'

vetoer.description: Who holds the veto stamp, or empty for nobody

stamps.description: How many veto stamps they get, 0 to 5
